## Changes
- **Smaller wordmark** – the "ArrHub" text next to the logo is 15 % smaller: 24 px in the header (20 px on phones) and proportionally smaller in the README logo, so the name sits in better balance with the icon

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.3.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
